requirements.verifier_assertion: rebase rewrites the moved revision's down_revision to the target so the downstream chain follows automatically, producing a single straight chain, without creating a new revision file.
rebasing onto base sets down_revision = None and leaves the docstring Revises: line empty; target base is accepted.
moved revisions display a Rebased from: line (in addition to Parent:) in chronological order oldest first; never-moved revisions produce byte-identical output with no extra line.
the audit trail accumulates each move's prior parent, records the literal base sentinel, and uses comma-space separators.
Script exposes a public rebased_from tuple of former parents oldest first; never-moved returns an empty tuple.
heads and non-verbose history show a (rebased) marker next to moved revisions alongside (head) and (branchpoint).
the rebase command stdout states the old parent with previously ... (previously base when applicable) and the new parent with down_revision is now ... (down_revision is now base when applicable).
both arguments accept full id / unique prefix / head / label@head; target additionally accepts base; resolution failures error and touch no file.
ScriptDirectory exposes a method performing the move and returning the reloaded Script; the CLI wraps it via command registration and rebase --help works.
only the moved file changes and only its down_revision assignment / Revises: line / Rebased from: line; a type annotation and trailing comment on the assignment are preserved.
must_include: not a single byte of any other file

requirements.verifier_assertion: if there is not exactly one module-level down_revision assignment, the tool refuses to rewrite and errors.
after the rewrite, heads/history reflect the new structure and not a stale compile cache, even when the file timestamp and size are unchanged.
if the rewritten file fails to parse or yields an invalid graph, the file is restored to its pre-rewrite bytes and the error is reported.
must_include: restore the file to its pre-rewrite bytes

requirements.verifier_assertion: guarded cases error and touch no file: onto itself, already under target, merge point (multiple down_revisions), descendant/cycle, sourceless directory.
after the move upgrade/downgrade follow the new chain in online and --sql offline modes with consistent ordering; stamp works; branch_labels and depends_on are preserved.
the existing test suite keeps passing, tests are added for the feature, and docs/build/branches.rst gains a usage section.
